

# bootok.exe is all Rust (bootok-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/bootok-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# bootok.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/bootok-rust/src/bootok/bootok.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(bootok_res OBJECT bootok.rc)
target_compile_definitions(bootok_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(bootok_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(bootok bootok-cargo bootok.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE bootok-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS bootok_res)
